projection.name: couchbase
projection.title: Couchbase
projection.description: Couchbase Server cockpit: buckets, scopes and collections, JSON documents, SQL++ with an index advisor, live cluster and DCP metrics, a data map, and XDCR activity.

fields.label: Host
fields.help: Any cluster node; the management API resolves the rest of the topology.

fields.label: Query port
fields.help: SQL++ (N1QL) service port: 8093 plain, 18093 with TLS.

fields.label: Default bucket
fields.help: Pre-selects this bucket in the workspace bucket picker.

fields.label: Stored password
fields.help: Reusable Couchbase RBAC credential; its identity supplies the username.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks bucket, scope, collection, document, and index mutations, and every mutating SQL++ statement.

fields.label: Confirm write statements
fields.help: The SQL++ editor asks for confirmation before running a mutating or administrative statement.

fields.label: Query scan consistency
fields.help: request_plus waits for the index to catch up with recent mutations before answering a SQL++ read.

fields.label: Redacted fields
fields.help: Comma or newline separated regular expressions for document fields and result columns that must be masked.

config.emptyText: No nodes reported by this cluster.
No buckets yet. Create one to store documents.

config.ariaLabel: Bucket data map: scopes, collections, and document counts
config.instructions: Use the arrow keys to move between collections, Home and End to jump to the first or last one. Each bar is one collection, sized by its share of the largest collection in the bucket.

config.emptyText: No global secondary indexes.
No RBAC users are defined on this cluster.
No cluster events recorded yet.

config.label: SQL++
config.emptyText: Run a SQL++ statement to see results.
config.initialQuery: SELECT k.* FROM system:keyspaces k ORDER BY k.`path` LIMIT 25;

config.label: Index advisor
config.emptyText: Paste a SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE, or MERGE statement to get index recommendations.
config.initialQuery: SELECT k.* FROM system:keyspaces k LIMIT 25;

config.emptyText: No saved SQL++ statements for this connection yet.
This bucket has no scopes beyond the defaults.
This bucket has no collections yet.

config.ariaLabel: Bucket data map: scopes, collections, and document counts
config.instructions: Use the arrow keys to move between collections, Home and End to jump to the first or last one. Each bar is one collection, sized by its share of the largest collection in the bucket.

config.emptyText: No DCP consumers are streaming from this bucket.
No indexes on this bucket.

config.label: SQL++
config.emptyText: Run a SQL++ statement to see results.
config.initialQuery: SELECT k.* FROM system:keyspaces k WHERE IFMISSING(k.`bucket`, k.`id`) = "${resource.name}" ORDER BY k.`path` LIMIT 25;

config.emptyText: This scope has no collections yet.

config.label: SQL++
config.emptyText: Run a SQL++ statement to see results.
config.initialQuery: SELECT k.* FROM system:keyspaces k WHERE IFMISSING(k.`bucket`, k.`id`) = "${resource.scope}" AND IFMISSING(k.`scope`, "_default") = "${resource.name}" ORDER BY k.`path` LIMIT 25;

config.emptyText: No documents in this collection yet.
No fields inferred; the collection may be empty.
No indexes cover this collection; queries fall back to a primary scan.

config.label: SQL++
config.emptyText: Run a SQL++ statement to see results.
config.initialQuery: SELECT META(d).id AS id, d.* FROM `${resource.scope}`.`${resource.namespace}`.`${resource.name}` d LIMIT 25;

config.label: Index advisor
config.emptyText: Paste a SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE, or MERGE statement to get index recommendations.
config.initialQuery: SELECT META(d).id AS id, d.* FROM `${resource.scope}`.`${resource.namespace}`.`${resource.name}` d WHERE d.type = "example" LIMIT 25;

config.emptyText: No remote cluster references are configured.
No replication, rebalance, or failover events recorded yet.

fields.label: Allow flush
fields.help: Permits destroying every document in the bucket in one operation.

fields.label: RAM quota (MB)
fields.help: Per-node memory quota; shrinking it below the resident working set forces ejections.

fields.label: Replicas
fields.help: Changing the replica count triggers a rebalance before it takes effect.

fields.label: Allow flush
fields.help: Permits destroying every document in the bucket in one operation.

actions.label: Compact
actions.confirmText: Start compaction now? It runs in the background and adds disk and CPU load.

actions.label: Flush
actions.confirmText: Delete every document in this bucket? The data cannot be recovered.

actions.label: Delete bucket
actions.confirmText: Delete this bucket with all of its scopes, collections, documents, and indexes?

actions.label: Drop scope
actions.confirmText: Drop this scope with every collection and document inside it?

fields.label: Document expiry (seconds)
fields.help: 0 uses the bucket default; -1 disables expiry for this collection.

actions.label: Drop collection
actions.confirmText: Drop this collection and every document it holds?

fields.label: Document
fields.help: A JSON object; Couchbase stores it verbatim under the document ID.

actions.label: Delete document
actions.confirmText: Delete the selected document(s)? Couchbase cannot undo this.

actions.label: Delete document
actions.confirmText: Delete this document? Couchbase cannot undo this.

fields.label: Primary index
fields.help: Indexes every document key in the collection.

fields.label: Indexed fields
fields.help: Fields are indexed in the order chosen; the leading field drives the index scan.

fields.label: Defer build
fields.help: Creates the index definition without building it, so several indexes can be built together.

actions.label: Drop index
actions.confirmText: Drop this index? Queries that relied on it fall back to a primary scan or fail.
